what: OI-126 push-vs-extraction: which PREDECLARED reading the measurement matched

predeclaration.note: committed BEFORE the probe ran; the thresholds below are quoted from it, not chosen now

probe.run: inside salloc 57020313, -A m3246 -C cpu -q interactive, 21 s wall, exit 0, empty stderr

CONTROL.predeclared: median |R_push/R_xsec - 1| <= 0.10 over p_parallel<6 GeV, else UNINFORMATIVE
CONTROL.reading: the truth-side binning reproduces the extraction to 0.139% in the control region, so the band readings are usable

PREDECLARED_THRESHOLDS_AS_WRITTEN.EXTRACTION: median R_push in [0.80, 1.25] while median R_xsec >= 2.0
PREDECLARED_THRESHOLDS_AS_WRITTEN.UNINFORMATIVE: control fails, or median R_xsec < 2.0 in the band

VERDICT: TRAINING. The p_parallel deficit is ALREADY PRESENT in the trained push: R_push and R_xsec agree to a median ratio of 1.0000 in the band, so the extraction introduces essentially nothing and carries the training difference faithfully.
WHAT_THIS_EXONERATES: gate5_signal_factor_applied_to_truth_counts, which OI-126 named as the suspect after the target was refuted. The extraction path is now measured to be faithful in both regions, so no factor it applies can be the cause. THE SUSPECT IS RETIRED, NOT MERELY UNCONFIRMED.

SECONDARY_PREDECLARED_AND_REALIZED.declared: if TRAINING, p_parallel-separability should survive in R_push
SECONDARY_PREDECLARED_AND_REALIZED.realized: yes -- separability survives in the push, as declared; no surprise to report

THE_SIGN_REVERSAL_ALSO_LIVES_IN_THE_PUSH.note: the >20 GeV reversal is a training effect too, on the same evidence

SCOPE_NOTE_ON_THE_CELL_COUNT: this probe compares the nominal against replica_00 ALONE, so the cells with R_xsec>1.5 number 65 here and are not identical to the family-mean 63 of OI-126. The band definition used for the reading is GEOMETRIC (p_parallel columns 10-15, 84 cells), which is replica-independent and was fixed in the predeclaration.
WHAT_THIS_STILL_DOES_NOT_DO_all_five_dec: does NOT clear OI-126, which blocks pairing C_stat with P5A
does NOT identify the factor's value or form -- only that it is not introduced by the extraction
does NOT show whether C_stat survives a CENTRED reduction; not computed
does NOT show P5A is right; a nominal agreeing with the MC prior is consistent with a correct measurement and with an unfolding that barely moved
one replica is not the family; the family-level statement remains the mechanism receipt's
NOT_VERIFIED_LANGUAGE: nothing here is 'verified'. The probe is one script by one lane and its internal asserts are self-checks. C_stat itself is NOT independently verified -- VL132 records ONE builder where OI-121 authorized two blind ones.
WHAT_IT_MEANS_FOR_OI_126_stated_narrowly: the divergence is in the FIT. The only input difference between the arms is a Poisson(1) bootstrap on the measured target (established read-only earlier), so the OmniFold fit changes by a factor of ~5 in p_parallel 6-20 GeV under Poisson resampling of the measured leg -- in bins MINERvA reports at 1.6% statistical uncertainty. Whether that makes C_stat an unsuitable statistical-uncertainty proxy or the estimator unstable there is a DECISION this measurement does not make.

ANNOTATED_20260815_replica_00_IS_A_HIGH_.by: peer session B, on the mediator's dispatch to measure the within-arm sigma
ANNOTATED_20260815_replica_00_IS_A_HIGH_.measured: band R_push across all 50 replicas: mean 3.5969, sd(ddof=1) 1.6091, median 3.0418, range 1.0859 to 6.8865. replica_00's 5.0467 sits at the 70th percentile, z = +0.90.
ANNOTATED_20260815_replica_00_IS_A_HIGH_.what_this_corrects: this receipt's band figures are a SINGLE DRAW and were reported without a spread, because none was on the record. Any downstream sentence of the form 'the band effect is a factor of 5' should read 'a factor of ~3.6 on the family average, 1.09 to 6.89 across the 50 draws'. The original values are retained above rather than refreshed.
ANNOTATED_20260815_replica_00_IS_A_HIGH_.what_this_does_NOT_correct: the MATCHED reading of TRAINING is unaffected. It rests on R_push and R_xsec agreeing WITHIN replica_00 (median ratio 1.0000) and on the control region -- neither involves the family spread, and a high draw common to both arms of one ratio cancels. The predeclared thresholds were met by margins far larger than 1.6: R_push 5.05 against a >= 2.0 trigger, and the EXTRACTION branch required R_push in [0.80, 1.25], which even the LOWEST of the 50 draws (1.0859) would not have satisfied on the ratio test because R_xsec tracks it. STATED AS A MARGIN CHECK, NOT RE-RUN: the per-replica R_xsec comparison was not recomputed for all 50.
